title: Function decision matrix
description: One function's decision matrix, at packages/naive/src/functions/<id>/decisions.json: for each decision class (packages/naive/template/governance/decision-rights.json) the function's work raises, whether its agent decides, recommends for an approver, or escalates to a person. It is the RACI/DACI view of the venture-wide decision rights for one function, and never loosens them: a class in delegation.json one_way_doors or never_redelegated is always escalate (packages/naive/src/checks/check-functions.ts). A venture tightens a row in its own governance, never here.

level.description: decide: the agent decides and records it. recommend: the agent proposes, the approver decides. escalate: a person decides; the agent prepares the decision with evidence.

approver.description: For recommend: the role that decides (a lead id, chief-of-staff or founder).

examples.description: Concrete decisions of this class in this function, as the founder would say them.
